xBRIEFInfo.description: Emergency patch cohort for v0.79.1 — adoption-blocker Write gate + release-smoothness fixes

plan.title: Emergency patch 0.79.1: Write-gate propose exemption + release cohort

narratives.Description: Ship a patch release fixing the Write-gate chicken-and-egg adoption blocker (#2625) plus the v0.79.0 cut friction bugs (#2622, #2623, #2621, #2615) and clear coverage debt (#2618) without a second soft-pass.
narratives.Overview: Primary: exempt xbrief/proposed (and legacy vbrief/proposed) lifecycle artifact writes from the active-scope Write gate, and fix circular recovery text. Secondary: reconcile duplicate completed basename skip, release skill closeout that commits enforce-branches while opt-in is still on, PowerShell-safe coverage-debt docs, resolve pr-monitor.js via @deftai/directive package on npm installs, lift branch coverage >= 85%.
narratives.UserStory: As a consumer agent between milestones, I can Write a new proposed xBRIEF without an active scope. As a maintainer, the next patch cut does not stall on reconcile collisions, uncommitted policy restore, PowerShell # stripping, or missing pr-monitor paths — and does not reuse coverage-debt soft-pass.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Hook dispatcher: extract write target path; allow proposed lifecycle artifact writes when ritual is ready; improve deny recovery when target is proposed/.
2. applyLifecycleFixes: on target-exists in completed/ for closed issue, skip (already-terminal) instead of fail.
3. Release skill: document/enforce closeout order — commit enforce flip before protection is relied on as dirty-tree blocker.
4. Docs/help: PowerShell-safe --allow-coverage-debt=N examples.
5. cliScriptPath: resolve via createRequire('@deftai/directive') with monorepo fallback.
6. Tests covering each fix; confirm branch coverage >= 85% (close #2618).
7. CHANGELOG [Unreleased]; pre-PR; patch release 0.79.1.
narratives.Acceptance: Write of xbrief/proposed/*.xbrief.json allowed with empty active/ when ritual fresh; other writes still gated. Reconcile apply exits 0 on proposed+completed same basename. Release skill closeout commits enforce. Docs show =N form. wait-mergeable finds pr-monitor under published @deftai/directive. Branch coverage >= 85% without debt flag.
